color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Fresh observation before new planning
Background extension also checks its retained job

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Execution barrier raised?
For example: failed background evidence

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Opt-in background work: unfinished single craft
returned with fully accepted paid native receipt?
Actor, queue, products and inventory match?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist job and original attempt in background
Release paid-input reservation; lock future outputs
Preserve native-start deadline; clear foreground plan

div.style: color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Every later observation checks job identity,
monotonic progress, deadline and earned output
Persist before allowing independent work

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(46, 72, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record verified completion; unlock outputs
Clear background job and attempt; persist

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Allow only independent gather, insert, extract
or wait without touching locked products
Use the same serial dispatcher

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Background extension: acknowledged craft-idle
or research wait with independent ready work?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Expected effect now observed?
Use the action's exact postcondition

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Original ambiguous native transfer has exact
same-unit receipt for less than requested?
Zero quantity also requires retained source

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Prepared original transfer: approach started/returned,
transfer RPC never entered; no observation error,
no receipt; same unit, source and reservation?
Fresh preconditions and maintenance gate allow?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Persist recovery authorization and original phases
Dispatch identical transfer with original attempt
Persist returned state, then reobserve

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(84, 62, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Retain original pending and attempt
Mark dispatch ambiguous after backend error
Do not replay an unproved transfer

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(67, 59, 83) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ambiguous place: absent role and zero global count
Ambiguous connection: zero connector count
Both require retained reserved materials
Prepared/ambiguous gather: after a prior poll,
gain above baseline but below target

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: factory_wait with boiler coal below five?

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Ready-work: acknowledged machine-output wait
has an allowed, unsatisfied non-wait candidate?

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Finish nonmutating wait; clear plan
Replan maintenance or available useful work

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;
color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Step tick timeout or poll limit reached?
Factory-enabled controllers use at least 1,800 polls

div.style: color: rgb(75, 65, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(89, 53, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Mark uncertain; retain unresolved evidence
Preserve pending, attempt and reservations
Require valid reconciliation before mutation

div.style: color: rgb(36, 59, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Keep observing without redispatch
Real game time advances naturally
Only explicit mock mode dispatches idle for time

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Save checkpoint; append configured logs
Publish truthful status, decisions and evidence

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Increment plan failure count
Release reservation and clear plan
Retain failures and paid construction

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
Record verified attempt; release reservation
Clear pending, advance step
Reset stalled-decision count

div.style: color: rgb(61, 78, 70) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Unhandled controller, persistence
or backend failure
